mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{actorId} AND r.role_code = 'super_admin' AND r.status = 1
SELECT primary_dept_id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{actorId}

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.data_scope_type AS dataScopeType FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{actorId} AND m.auth_code = #{code} UNION SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.data_scope_type AS dataScopeType FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{actorId} AND p.permission_code = #{code}
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, status FROM sys_menu WHERE auth_code = #{code}
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, status FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT dept_id FROM sys_role_dept_scope WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId FROM sys_dept
